title: Senior AI Engineer
summary: Design, build and ship production AI systems — from retrieval and agents to evaluation and monitoring — alongside client teams.
about: You'll join our AI practice to take promising ideas from prototype to production. You'll work closely with product, data and design colleagues and with client engineers, building systems people rely on every day.
responsibilities: Design and build LLM-powered features, retrieval pipelines and agent workflows
Set up evaluation, guardrails and monitoring so systems stay reliable in production
Pair with client engineers and help them grow their own AI capability
Shape technical direction and estimate effort with delivery leads
requirements: 5+ years of software engineering, with recent hands-on work on ML or LLM systems
Strong Python and experience with at least one major cloud platform
Practical understanding of evaluation, latency and cost trade-offs
Clear communicator who enjoys working directly with clients

title: Data Engineer
summary: Build the reliable, well-governed data platforms that analytics and AI depend on.
about: You'll help clients move from scattered legacy data to platforms their teams trust — modelling data, building pipelines and putting quality and governance in from day one.
responsibilities: Build batch and streaming pipelines on modern cloud data platforms
Model data for analytics and AI use cases with clear ownership and documentation
Implement data quality checks, lineage and access controls
Work with analysts and data scientists to turn requirements into datasets
requirements: 3+ years building production data pipelines
Strong SQL and Python; experience with a cloud data warehouse or lakehouse
Familiarity with orchestration, testing and CI for data
Curiosity about the business problem behind the data

title: Experience Designer
summary: Research, design and test digital experiences that make complex services feel simple.
about: You'll lead design on client teams — from discovery research to high-fidelity prototypes — making sure what we build works for the people who use it, including those with access needs.
responsibilities: Plan and run user research and turn insights into clear design direction
Design journeys, prototypes and interfaces, and test them with real users
Champion accessibility and inclusive design across the team
Work hand in hand with engineers through delivery
requirements: A portfolio showing end-to-end service or product design work
Experience running research and usability testing
Strong working knowledge of accessibility standards
Comfortable presenting and facilitating with clients

title: Delivery Lead
summary: Lead multidisciplinary teams to deliver measurable outcomes for clients, on time and with care.
about: You'll own the delivery of client engagements: shaping plans, building healthy teams, managing risk and keeping everyone focused on the outcome the client needs.
responsibilities: Plan and lead delivery for one or more client teams
Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders
Track outcomes, budget and risk, and communicate clearly and early
Coach team members and improve how we deliver
requirements: Experience leading agile delivery of digital or data products
Strong stakeholder management in a consulting or client-facing setting
Commercial awareness of scope, budget and change
A calm, people-first leadership style

title: Strategy Consultant
summary: Help leaders set direction on AI, customer experience and operating models — and turn strategy into action.
about: You'll work with senior client leaders to frame problems, analyse options and build practical roadmaps — then stay close to delivery so strategy turns into results.
responsibilities: Frame business problems and lead structured analysis
Facilitate workshops with senior stakeholders
Build business cases, roadmaps and operating-model designs
Partner with delivery teams to carry strategy into execution
requirements: 3+ years in strategy consulting or a strategy role in industry
Strong analytical and storytelling skills
Interest in technology and AI and how they change organizations
Confident working with senior leaders

title: Cloud Platform Engineer
summary: Build secure, automated cloud platforms that let product teams ship quickly and safely.
about: You'll design and automate cloud foundations — networking, identity, CI/CD and observability — and help clients modernize legacy workloads onto them.
responsibilities: Design and build cloud landing zones and platform services as code
Automate build, test and deployment pipelines
Improve reliability, security and cost visibility
Support teams migrating and modernizing applications
requirements: Hands-on experience with a major cloud provider and infrastructure as code
Solid grounding in networking, identity and security
Experience with containers and CI/CD
A collaborative approach to enabling other teams
